==Description==
The '''Energy Drink''' is a common consumable exclusively uses in [[PVP]] mode.

It can be used an unlimited number of times, but it costs {{Money|1,400}} to use each time. It has a 50 second cooldown.

==Usage==
Upon use, the '''Energy Drink''' would add the [[Nimble]] attribute to three enemies sent by the team the player is in. These attributes would be put in a queue, meaning all the previously sent attributes needed to be applied first. It only applied it to three enemies, not three groups of enemies. For example, if nine [[Normal]]s were sent in a single group, only three of them will be [[Nimble]].

==Appearance==
The '''Energy Drink''' is an aluminium can with black and white label with Paradoxum Games logo.
